bindings.name: Truth Compass
rules: Resolve the current canonical repository head before making current-state claims.
Founder Control Room remains authoritative for project truth, evidence, approvals, receipts, continuity, and consequential execution boundaries.
If the canonical read path is unavailable, fail closed as UNKNOWN or BLOCKED rather than substituting demo, seed, browser-local, generated, or model-produced state.

bindings.name: Exact Match Engine
rules: Browser-local and seeded state is demo evidence only and may never be promoted to portfolio truth.
External launch proof requires a real non-founder user to complete the module loop; a completion receipt alone does not prove user identity.
Real reconciliation observations must bind repository, ref, exact SHA, and evidence source.
If Founder Control Room evidence is unavailable, return UNKNOWN or BLOCKED rather than falling back to seeded state.

bindings.name: Truth Weaver
rules: Chief AI owns reasoning, synthesis, capability composition, and recommendations; Founder Control Room remains the portfolio authority repository.
A stronger model, strategic lens, or higher confidence never increases authority.
If Chief or Founder Control Room truth cannot be resolved, fail closed as UNKNOWN or BLOCKED.
